channel_name: Kontak OJK 157 / Portal Aplikasi Pelindungan Konsumen (APAK)
jurisdiction_scope: National Financial Services and Insurance Consumer Protection
procedure_summary: Consumers who have submitted a complaint to an insurer without satisfactory resolution within 10 to 20 working days may lodge an official grievance with OJK Kontak 157 or request mediation through LAPS SJK.
published_deadlines: Insurer response required within maximum 10 working days, extendable by 10 working days for complex cases pursuant to POJK 22/2023
filing_guidance: Submit copy of active insurance policy and official claim denial letter from insurer
Provide chronology of dispute and chronological evidence of interaction with insurer customer service
Attach identity card (KTP/KITAS) and statement confirming dispute is not currently in litigation
